title: Rails, /about as a file in public/
notes: The generated Rails application with /about as a hand-written file in public/, served by Rails' static file middleware. Only the static page differs from the default entry.
details: The Rails entry with one change: /about is a hand-written public/about.html, answered by ActionDispatch::Static (Rails' own static file middleware, on by default) before the router, the session and the layout are reached, with the far-future cache-control header that the generated production settings give public files. The Rails entry renders the same page from a view on each request. Only the static-page task differs; the other three run the same code as the Rails entry. Everything else is the Rails entry, and its notes apply. Gems are installed one at a time from gems.lock.json after their age and sha256 are checked, and loaded through Bundler with a frozen Gemfile.lock; seven of them (bigdecimal, bootsnap, msgpack, nio4r, puma, racc, websocket-driver) compile native extensions at install.
